title: 12 years ago I graduated from college with a degree in Game Design. Today with the help of Claude I made my senior project a real playable game on Newgrounds.
author: ThirdEye_FGC
selftext:
Today I'm thrilled to announce that my next game, "O.C.U" is officially available to play on Newgrounds!  
  
[https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1047551](https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1047551?fbclid=IwcGRvZgVleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFCMW5uTGIzSktDQTFmUk5Mc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHmg6-TBkXgpY7TW3dQoVEOV7KK9a3LcbSkFPArn0xw14Jrv_RT7oYTtQSFp8_aem_CS-wj4a5AqkUPe6s_YY70g)

O.C.U is a 2-player card game. Free in your browser. No install, no account setup. Share the link with a friend to play head to head online.

GAME FEATURES

— Three casters CPU difficulties from the reckless Disaster Caster to Masters Caster, who counts every card you've spent.

— Pass and play on one device, hands hidden between turns.

— Online: share a four-digit code with anyone, anywhere.

— Random Caster match: Connect with another caster who is queued up.

— Thirty puzzles across three difficulties, where the cards are fixed and some puzzles have only one answer.

— Original soundtrack by me
